what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: HYBRID MEETING (in person and on Zoom). Zoom Link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/7663167607?omn=88940537553 — Meeting ID: 766 316 760

items.why_it_matters: This is the committee's approval of bills already paid, totaling the amount released from school funds for that period.

items.agenda_line: a. Public Interview of Business Administrator-Derrick Andrews (10 min)
items.why_it_matters: A candidate for the district's top financial staff position is being publicly interviewed by the committee.

items.agenda_line: 10. Executive Session- to consider or interview applicants for employment or appointment by a preliminary screening committee.
items.why_it_matters: The committee will go behind closed doors to discuss hiring for a staff position, a step that precedes any public vote on a candidate.
The committee will discuss a grant that brings outside funding into the school budget.

items.agenda_line: d. Vote to Approve Warrant Articles 9/3/26 Town Meeting (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee will vote on its position for articles going before the Town's fall Town Meeting, which can affect school funding or facilities.
The committee is set to formally sign off on a contract governing the school cafeteria service.
The committee will discuss whether to commission a financial audit of the district.
The committee will discuss its own governing procedures, which can affect how future decisions get made and disclosed.

items.agenda_line: a. FY26 Year End Budget review (5 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee will review how the prior fiscal year's budget actually played out compared to what was approved.
